rules.message: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY inside a BEGIN...COMMIT transaction block aborts at runtime with SQLSTATE 25001; retrieve postgres-schema-indexing-and-migrations.
keepWhen: Never valid inside an active PostgreSQL transaction block; split CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY into a standalone non-transactional migration step or use plain CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS in bootstrap schema.sql.
dropWhen: Match occurs inside SQL comments, markdown documentation strings, or a negative migration test deliberately asserting SQLSTATE 25001.

rules.message: Module-scoped mutable Map in API/service source diverges across horizontal replicas and risks unbounded memory growth; retrieve scale-ready-stateless-design.
keepWhen: Module belongs to a single-process build script, CLI utility, or read-only registry populated once during process startup and never mutated per request.
dropWhen: Occurrence lives in a unit/integration test mock, test fixture, or client-only ephemeral UI helper.
